# Navimower Map Card 0.3.6-beta3

## Multi mower compact UI polish

- Adds a shared **Map legend size** control (`0.5x`–`2.0x`) used by both Single and Multi mower maps while keeping the existing legend-opacity setting.
- Replaces the Multi mower plain-text zone labels with the same rounded zone-label pills used by Single mower view, including the same font-size, opacity and overlap-avoidance behavior.
- Keeps zone-label placement site-wide in Multi mode so labels from different mower maps can avoid each other and the scaled map legend.
- Removes the Single mower Status / Zone / Battery footer from Multi mower mode and guards it from reappearing after Home Assistant state updates.
- Moves the same information into each mower's own control card. Existing `Show status`, `Show physical zone`, `Show battery` and optional `Show X/Y position` toggles continue to control visibility.
- Adds compact map-marker and battery icons before each mower's zone and battery values.

This beta keeps the combined map alignment, mower ordering, per-mower Schedule, live trail, notification merge and session grouping from the previous 0.3.6 betas unchanged.
